marks.gloss_en: שלא ימצאו הלכה ברורה ומשנה ברורה במקום אחד (= p_yeshotetu_lo_halacha_brura)
R' Shimon ben Yochai: 'and not find' -- they will not find clear halakha and clear mishna in one place
איני?! והאמר רבי יהודה בר שילת אמר רבי אסי... אמר להו [רבי יוחנן]: יתעסקון ביה עממין -- R' Yochanan let gentiles attend to the dead on a Festival (kind svara under protest: no kind for איני/והאמר)
Rav Menashya: a canopy -- we went over every side of the canopy and found no side of permission
Rav Menashya: hops in a vineyard -- a [forbidden] mixture
because they are not people of Torah [-- said at 139a.17, 139a.18 and 139b.2 of why the leniency was not sent]
Rav would announce: whoever wants to sow hops in a vineyard, let him sow
Rav Mesharshiya would give a peruta to a gentile child, and he would sow [hops] for him
Rav Menashya: a dead person -- neither Jews nor Arameans attend to him, neither on the first Festival day nor on the second
if you see a generation on which many troubles come, go and examine the judges of Israel; for every calamity that comes to the world comes only because of the judges of Israel

they are wicked, but they placed their trust in Him who spoke and the world came to be; therefore the Holy One brings upon them three calamities corresponding to the three transgressions in their hands
the Holy One does not rest His Presence on Israel until the evil judges and officers cease from Israel
Ulla: Jerusalem is redeemed only through tzedaka
Rav Pappa: if the haughty cease, the amgushei cease
[that the amgushei cease with the haughty] as it is written: 'and I will purge your dross as with lye' (Isaiah 1:25)
[that the gzirpatei cease with the judges] as it is written: 'the Lord has removed your judgments, He has cast out your enemy' (Zephaniah 3:15)
'the Lord has broken the staff of the wicked' (Is 14:5) -- these are the judges who became a stick for their attendants
'for your hands are defiled with blood' (Is 59:3) -- these are the judges
from the day Joseph parted from his brothers he did not taste wine
R' Yosei b'R' Chanina: they [the brothers] too did not taste wine
R' Malai: in reward for 'and he will see you and be glad in his heart' (Ex 4:14), he merited the breastplate of judgment upon his heart
